name: Raw
note: Dash has no Grafana JSON; this is the portable dashboard definition. Contains no connection secrets.

panels.title: Hourly regional energy
panels.sql:
-- Section 7.1 / 7.3  Panel P1 (Raw): hourly regional energy, kWh.
-- Source: energy_readings (cleaned, 10,643,735 rows) JOIN meters for the region.
-- Range is the selected whole-CAT-day window [start, end), end exclusive.
-- Bucket origin 2026-09-01 00:00+02 aligns CAT hours.
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', r.event_time,
                   TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-01 00:00:00+02') AS bucket,
       m.region                                        AS region,
       sum(r.energy_kwh)                               AS energy_kwh
FROM energy_readings r
JOIN meters m USING (meter_id)
WHERE r.event_time >= %(start)s::timestamptz
  AND r.event_time <  %(end)s::timestamptz
GROUP BY bucket, m.region
ORDER BY bucket, m.region;

panels.title: Daily network energy
panels.sql:
-- Section 7.1 / 7.3  Panel P2 (Raw): daily network energy, kWh.
-- Source: energy_readings. Daily buckets align to CAT midnight (origin 2026-09-01).
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', r.event_time,
                   TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-01 00:00:00+02') AS bucket,
       sum(r.energy_kwh)                               AS energy_kwh
FROM energy_readings r
WHERE r.event_time >= %(start)s::timestamptz
  AND r.event_time <  %(end)s::timestamptz
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket;

panels.title: Network energy in seven-day periods
panels.sql:
-- Section 7.1 / 7.3  Panel P3 (Raw): network energy in the four seven-day
-- periods beginning 1, 8, 15 and 22 September, kWh, limited to the selected
-- range. One scan of energy_readings is re-bucketed to CAT days, then mapped
-- onto the four Section 5.1 periods (bucket origin 2026-09-01 00:00+02).
WITH periods(period, p_start, p_end, ord) AS (
    VALUES
      ('1-7 Sep',   TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-01 00:00:00+02', TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-08 00:00:00+02', 1),
      ('8-14 Sep',  TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-08 00:00:00+02', TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-15 00:00:00+02', 2),
      ('15-21 Sep', TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-15 00:00:00+02', TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-22 00:00:00+02', 3),
      ('22-28 Sep', TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-22 00:00:00+02', TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-29 00:00:00+02', 4)
),
daily AS (
    SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', r.event_time,
                       TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-01 00:00:00+02') AS d,
           sum(r.energy_kwh)                                   AS energy_kwh
    FROM energy_readings r
    WHERE r.event_time >= %(start)s::timestamptz
      AND r.event_time <  %(end)s::timestamptz
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT p.period          AS period,
       sum(daily.energy_kwh) AS energy_kwh
FROM periods p
JOIN daily
  ON daily.d >= GREATEST(p.p_start, %(start)s::timestamptz)
 AND daily.d <  LEAST(p.p_end,   %(end)s::timestamptz)
GROUP BY p.period, p.ord
ORDER BY p.ord;

panels.title: Daily energy of selected meter
panels.sql:
-- Section 7.1 / 7.3  Panel P4 (Raw): daily energy of the selected meter, kWh.
-- Source: energy_readings. The meter variable is used by this panel only.
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', r.event_time,
                   TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-01 00:00:00+02') AS bucket,
       sum(r.energy_kwh)                               AS energy_kwh
FROM energy_readings r
WHERE r.meter_id = %(meter)s
  AND r.event_time >= %(start)s::timestamptz
  AND r.event_time <  %(end)s::timestamptz
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket;

panels.title: Completeness by region
panels.sql:
-- Section 7.1 / 7.3  Panel P5 (Raw): completeness by region, percent.
-- observed = count(*) of cleaned energy_readings rows per region (the cleaned
-- table holds one row per meter_id + event_time pair, so count(*) equals the
-- unique observed pair count).
-- planned  = registered meters in the region x 96 readings/day x days in range.
-- days     = calendar days between the CAT-midnight bounds, end exclusive.
WITH reg AS (
    SELECT region, count(*) AS registered
    FROM meters
    GROUP BY region
),
obs AS (
    SELECT m.region, count(*) AS observed
    FROM energy_readings r
    JOIN meters m USING (meter_id)
    WHERE r.event_time >= %(start)s::timestamptz
      AND r.event_time <  %(end)s::timestamptz
    GROUP BY m.region
)
SELECT reg.region              AS region,
       reg.registered          AS registered,
       obs.observed            AS observed,
       reg.registered * 96
           * ((%(end)s::date - %(start)s::date))            AS planned,
       100.0 * obs.observed
           / (reg.registered * 96
              * ((%(end)s::date - %(start)s::date)))        AS completeness
FROM reg
JOIN obs USING (region)
ORDER BY split_part(reg.region, ' ', 2)::int;
